name_reason: Current name says 'play' but the call fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(bank, -1, 1) passes sfx_id == -1, which fd2_play_sfx_with_handle guards with `if (param_2 != 0xffffffff) { ...play... }` -- so it only runs AIL_stop_sample on the shared sample slot (data_fd2_audio_sfx_sample_handle_0) and returns before any playback. Actual playback of this bank is done earlier in the cast sequence by the sibling fd2_play_spell_palette_flash_with_sfx, which passes sfx_id 0. This function is the teardown: it STOPS the SFX then free()s the bank. Proposed fd2_stop_and_free_status_effect_sfx accurately reflects stop+free. Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; no address residue.
purpose: Teardown counterpart to fd2_load_status_effect_sfx: stop the currently-playing status-effect SFX (via the stop-only path of fd2_play_sfx_with_handle) and free the loaded SFX bank buffer.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(data_fd2_audio_status_effect_sfx_handle_ptr, 0xFFFFFFFF, 1). sfx_id == -1 routes that callee to its stop-only branch (AIL_stop_sample on the shared sample slot data_fd2_audio_sfx_sample_handle_0, then return -- no playback). Then free()s the bank buffer pointed to by data_fd2_audio_status_effect_sfx_handle_ptr. Watcom emits the final free as a tail call (JMP 0x1a80a into fd2_maybe_free_speed_mode_overlay's shared `CALL free; ADD ESP,4; RET` epilogue); reproduced in src as a plain free(). __CHK(0x10) prologue is compiler-injected. Cyclomatic complexity 1, single basic block.
comment_original_issue: Source comment said the function 'play the loaded status-effect SFX bank in kill-all mode (handle == -1 tells fd2_play_sfx_with_handle to stop every currently-playing sample first)'. Two inaccuracies: (1) sfx_id == -1 is the stop-only path -- it never starts playback, so 'play' is wrong; the operation is stop+free. (2) fd2_play_sfx_with_handle stops only the single shared sample slot data_fd2_audio_sfx_sample_handle_0, not 'every currently-playing sample'. The __CHK note and the Watcom tail-call epilogue note were correct and were preserved.
notes: Caller sequence (fd2_spell_selection_menu_main 0x1cff0 and siblings) confirms intent: fd2_load_status_effect_sfx() loads FDOTHER.DAT[0x50]; fd2_play_spell_palette_flash_with_sfx(spell_id) plays sample 0 (PLAY); spell handler runs; then this function stops the SFX and frees the bank (TEARDOWN). Name verdict recorded only, not applied (Stage 2). No logic changed; only the source comment block and the Ghidra plate were edited.
